design.purpose: A weatherproof-looking outdoor planter for herbs or flowers for one household; interior about 41 × 11 cm with 20 cm soil depth before lining.

steps.c: Cut front, back and two 11 cm ends.
Cut the 45 cm base from board-c.
Drill three 5 mm drainage holes in base.
Place the base flat on the floor.
Stand the front side on the base.
Stand the back side on the base.
Fit the left end between the sides.
Fit the right end between the sides.
Screw the front to the left end (2 screws)
Screw the front to the right end (2 screws)
Screw the back to the left end (2 screws)
Screw the back to the right end (2 screws)
Screw the base up into the front (2 screws)
Screw the base up into the back (2 screws)
Screw the base up into the left end (2 screws)
Screw the base up into the right end (2 screws)
